title: Standardizing plant names with WorldFloraFast
text: default, WFO.match() uses matching steps WorldFlora, three corrections can switched : correctly spelled genus replaced another one (Fuzzy.keep.genus), fuzzy matches must similar epithet (Fuzzy.epithet.check), placeholders “indet.” “sp.” matched (Fuzzy.skip.placeholder). neither name first two words found, falls back genus. WorldFloraFast offers three optional steps names, switched default: genus, epithet (Fuzzy.genus): truncated misspelled genera; genus transfer (Fuzzy.transfer): epithet another genus family, backbone shows species moved submitted genus genus; strict genus fall-back (Fuzzy.one.strict): genus first word accepted genus name, local names given scientific name. “Reinwardtiod cinerum” Reinwardtiodendron cinereum: epithet found genus starts “Reinwardtiod” (Reinwardtia, closer spelling). “Chrysophyllum madagascariensis”, Sapotaceae contain several species epithet, Gambeya madagascariensis belongs accepted species (Gambeya boiviniana) also synonym Chrysophyllum (Chrysophyllum boivinianum): Chrysophyllum species Madagascar moved Gambeya. “Palma colorada” local name. Palma Mill. synonym Phoenix, genus fall-back used name stays unmatched. Matches found steps flagged checked. Fuzzy matching recognise every local name: names backbone (genus Guayaba) matched, agrep() can find local name within longer scientific name, giving large Fuzzy.dist.
